title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 (Fort Mason, San Francisco) — keynote 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET, livestreamed, same day as CoreWeave Fully Connected day 1
source: EST: TWO company primaries now agree, both re-fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200). devday.openai.com reads verbatim 'Tuesday, September 29, 2026' at 'Fort Mason in San Francisco', states 'The opening keynote will be livestreamed', prices registration at $650, records that 'Applications to attend OpenAI DevDay in-person are now closed', and publishes the Pacific-time schedule verbatim — Breakfast 8 a.m., Opening Keynote 10:00 a.m., Breakouts 11:15 a.m.-3:30 p.m., Closing Session 4:00 p.m., Reception 4:45-7 p.m. The 10:00 a.m. PT keynote is 13:00 ET, i.e. MID-SESSION for US equities, not pre- or post-market. openai.com/index/devday-2026/ — recorded 403 to a plain fetcher by the proposing crwv-fully-connected-2026-09-29 ledger on this same date — served HTTP 200 to a browser-headed fetch this session and reads 'Save the date for September 29th in San Francisco'; that block is therefore CLEARED, not carried forward. events.openai.com/devdayexchange2026 separately lists the DevDay Exchange series (Bengaluru 10-16, Tokyo 10-20, Seoul 10-22, Berlin 10-26, Paris 10-28, London 11-03, Sao Paulo 11-06, Mexico City 11-10). The date is NOT in doubt. It stays `estimate` on ONE mechanical count only: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for a private company that files nothing and has no security to price — the same schema gap jgb-20y-auction-2026-09-15 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 both recorded for non-issuer publishers. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: PROPOSED by the crwv-fully-connected-2026-09-29 D-14 adjacency sweep (2026-09-15) as proposals/openai-devday-2026-09-29.from-crwv-fully-connected-2026-09-29.json; this canonical file is written by the initial research the same day and shadows it. The proposal called the OpenAI->CRWV channel 'real but UNMEASURED (n=0)'. It is now MEASURED, and the measurement cuts against the channel: across all three prior DevDays (2023-11-06, 2024-10-01, 2025-10-06) every tracked AI name's excess-vs-QQQ sat inside its own trailing-252 mean |excess| on the day, with exactly ONE exception — AMD +23.71% on 2025-10-06 — and that exception is attributable to a SEPARATELY ANNOUNCED commercial contract (the OpenAI 6GW partnership plus a 160M-share warrant, amd.com/ir.amd.com/openai.com press releases the same morning), not to keynote content. CRWV traded through exactly one DevDay (2025-10-06) and did -0.70% / -1.45pp excess on the day and -3.22pp excess on D+1, both well inside its own 4.71pp since-IPO mean |excess|. So the read-through runs through WHO OPENAI NAMES IN A CONTRACT, not through the developer-platform keynote — and on the one observation available, the counterparty named was AMD, a CoreWeave competitor, and CRWV fell. The direction of DevDay risk to CRWV is therefore NEGATIVE-SKEWED, not symmetric. Impact stays medium: a stage that has demonstrably hosted a supplier-repricing contract announcement is more than noise, and the keynote lands 13:00 ET mid-session on day 1 of CoreWeave's own Fully Connected conference in the same city, but the keynote's own content has n=3 measured non-events. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action, and no CRWV playbook survives (S1 killed). See docs/research/events/openai-devday-2026-09-29.md.
